title: Calendar, Admin Panel by @sajon_co: People don’t open productivity apps to admire the UI. They open them t
notes:
People don’t open productivity apps to admire the UI. They open them to regain control of their time. Good design acknowledges that by removing friction, reducing noise, and turning a busy schedule into something understandable at a glance. This screen is built around that idea: clarity first.

Designer: @sajon_co. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
